tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Your PinnFeed plan, limits (sports, rate, daily quota, data delay) and requests used today. Call first to know what you can query.

tools.name: get_closing_odds
tools.description: Closing odds (last prematch price before kickoff) for an event, for closing-line-value analysis. Builder plan and above.

tools.name: get_drops
tools.description: Biggest odds drops (prices shortening) in the last N minutes: from/to decimal price and drop %. Useful to spot steam and sharp money.

sport.description: Sport slug: soccer, tennis, basketball, hockey, american-football, baseball, rugby, mma, boxing, volleyball-handball, esports, golf, cricket. Comma-separate for several.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: One event with all its markets and prices by event id.

tools.name: get_live_odds
tools.description: Current in-play Pinnacle odds for a sport (decimal + American prices, no-vig fair odds, margin, max stake). Main markets by default.

sport.description: Sport slug: soccer, tennis, basketball, hockey, american-football, baseball, rugby, mma, boxing, volleyball-handball, esports, golf, cricket. Comma-separate for several.

tools.name: get_prematch_odds
tools.description: Current prematch (pre-game) Pinnacle odds for a sport: only events that have not kicked off yet, with open markets, soonest first. Same fields as get_live_odds; each market has updatedAt (last price change, ISO 8601 UTC) and the response has asOf.

sport.description: Sport slug: soccer, tennis, basketball, hockey, american-football, baseball, rugby, mma, boxing, volleyball-handball, esports, golf, cricket. Comma-separate for several.

tools.name: list_sports
tools.description: All sports with live and prematch event counts and whether each is in your plan.

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Find events (fixtures) by sport, team or league text, live or prematch (prematch = not kicked off yet; live first, then soonest first). Returns ids, teams, league, start time, score/clock when live. No prices: use get_event or get_*_odds for prices.

sport.description: Sport slug: soccer, tennis, basketball, hockey, american-football, baseball, rugby, mma, boxing, volleyball-handball, esports, golf, cricket. Comma-separate for several.

q.description: Team or league text, e.g. "Arsenal" or "Premier League".

live.description: true = in-play only, false = prematch only, omit = both.
